prompt_to_os_agent: Create /work/trajectory_dependent/input.txt with the three lines gamma, alpha, beta. Then create /work/trajectory_dependent/output.txt by sorting input.txt alphabetically and converting the lines to uppercase. Then create /work/trajectory_dependent/manifest.txt containing the SHA256 checksum of output.txt in the standard sha256sum format. Finally verify the checksum using manifest.txt and print the verification result.

evaluation.probe: [ "$(cat /work/trajectory_dependent/output.txt 2>/dev/null)" = $'ALPHA\nBETA\nGAMMA' ] && cd /work/trajectory_dependent && sha256sum -c manifest.txt >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo true || echo false
